summary.zh: 戴礼帽和眼罩的怪盗猫从墙后冒出来，左看右看，抬帽致意，甩出一张旋转的预告函钉在墙上，然后缩回墙头只露出眼睛偷看。一段循环的小剧情，舞台永远不空。
summary.en: A top-hatted, masked thief cat pops up from behind a wall, glances left and right, tips its hat, flicks a spinning calling card that pins to the wall, then sinks back to peek over the ledge. A looping micro-story that never leaves the stage empty.

technique.zh: 一条 async 时间线串起 6 个动作；冒头带 4% 过冲；只移动瞳孔做「看」；卡片从爪子位置 translate + rotate(2 圈 + 6deg) + scale 飞出，落定瞬间出现图钉并压缩一下。
technique.en: Six beats on one async timeline: a 4% overshoot on the pop-up; only the pupils move to “look”; the card flies from the paw with translate + rotate(2 turns + 6deg) + scale, and a pin appears with a small squash on landing.

adapt.zh: 预告函的文案改 .card 里的内容，适合做发布预告、彩蛋。
adapt.en: Edit the text in .card; nice for launch teasers or easter eggs.
